what: Case 4 first subcase cap math is wrong for mav-resume-past-cap
scenario_or_breakage: With base_cap=5 and five prior rounds DEGRADED_ROUND=true, count_prior_degraded_rounds(..., 6) yields prior_deg=5 and entry_effective_cap=10; STARTING_ROUND=6 is not > 10, so hoisted mav-resume never fires and the test fails or passes for the wrong reason
suggested_fix: Use STARTING_ROUND=11 (or base_cap+prior_deg+1) for the inflated-cap mav-resume subcase, or change the assertion to expect normal loop entry (not mav-resume) when STARTING_ROUND is within the inflated cap
